info: Plan D (from v13). No study room – bedroom 3 is the study with two 1000 mm standing desks facing the window. D1 = desks only; D2 adds a fold-down super-single wall bed on the east wall (choose D2 in the option menu to see it folded or down). Hall tall cabinets and the seamless marble TV wall follow v13 (rebuilt from their dimensions, so details are simplified). Kitchen: closed or open with bi-fold glass; open keeps the stove-side top cabinets and a ducted hood. Removing the kitchen front wall must be confirmed with HDB / your ID. Power points and trunking are indicative.
